photon.title: Photon
photon.description: TIHLDE's new backend solution. A Hono REST API utilizing postgres, redis, drizzle, and typescript.

coursestats.title: CourseStats
coursestats.description: Course statistics for norwegian universities. A NextJS fullstack application using sqlite, drizzle, and typescript. Uses publicly available data from the HKDIR DBH api.

kontres.title: KontRes
kontres.description: TIHLDE's booking solution. A NextJS tRPC fullstack application using postgres, prisma, and typescript. The auth solution is tightly integrated with our backend, LEPTON.

kvark.title: Kvark / Lepton
kvark.description: TIHLDE's frontend / backend solution. A React SPA frontend utilizing Tanstack router and query. And a Django python backend.
